# Calculators.RealMarketAPI

> Free professional trading calculators for forex, gold, crypto, stocks, indices and commodities.
> Powered by RealMarketAPI — real-time market data API for traders, AI agents, and dashboards.

## Calculators
- [Position Size Calculator](/position-size): Ideal lot size from account, risk %, and stop loss.
- [Risk Calculator](/risk): Dollar and percentage risk for a planned trade.
- [Margin Calculator](/margin): Required margin and margin usage by leverage.
- [Drawdown Calculator](/drawdown): Drawdown % and recovery needed.
- [Profit Calculator](/profit): P/L and ROI for long or short trades.

## Related
- RealMarketAPI: https://realmarketapi.com
- Learn: https://learn.realmarketapi.com
